gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dgongs gter dbang phyug zor mdos kyi bka' gtad bya thabs bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī yai/dbang phyug zo

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dgongs gter dbang phyug zor mdos kyi bka' gtad bya thabs bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī yai/

dbang phyug zor mdos kyi bka' gtad khol phyung du byed na/ bdag bskyed yi dam gang rung sngon du gtang yang chog la/ 'dir bdag bskyed bsdus pa yod pas zur du med kyang chog /mdos gdan g.yang gzhi'i steng zangs lcags kyi snod du kong bu zur gsum nang du dmar gtor bzhag pa dbus su che ba gcig la chung ba bzhis bskor/ rtsang gsum re bsnol mar gzug /'dzom na tshe dang yungs dkar gong bus brgyan/ sha khrag blug /sman raka gtor gsum dang nyer spyod dngos su bsham pa'am yid sprul gyis kyang 'thus/ gong ltar bca' gzhi grub nas slob ma mdun du 'khod// sems bskyed gsal gdab/ bka' gtad zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug /slob dpon gyis bsgom bzlas byas te/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: ye nas dam tshig pa dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin: rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa zhabs gar thabs mdzad pa: thugs kar nyi steng sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba: de'i mdun du ma mo mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad thams cad sprin ltar 'khrigs nas las bsgrub par gyur: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: brgya rtsa tsam bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'o// 1$0000270skad cig gis rang nyid gnas 'gyur: bdag dang mdun bskyed zor dang rtsang 1$0000300rnams so sor: mkha' 'gro byad zlog ma sku mdog lcags sreg lta bu: gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: khro mo'i chas thams cad rdzogs pa phyag gnyis zangs gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: sku smad lcags bsregs kyi phur pas ban bon nyams pa'i snying gar gzir ba:

de'i shar du dkar mo seng gdong: lhor ser mo stag gdong: nub tu dmar mo dred gdong: byang du nag mo dom gdong: thams cad kyang gtso mo lta bu rang rtags kyis mtshan pa'i zangs gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: seng ge dang stag dang dred dang dom gyi shun pa gyon pa sku smad lcags sreg gi phur pa can: 'khor dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba'o: bdag mdun thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs: bh+yo: mu le mtsho dang yongs 'du'i shing: dur khrod brgyad sogs bzhugs gnas nas: byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang mo nyer brgyad spyan 'dren no: sdang dgra'i steng du dgyes par bzhugs: oṃ pañca ḍā ki bh+yo sa ya si hrīṃ dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yi: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: bshos bu gzugs sgra dri ro dang: reg bya sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs: byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: 'khor bcas mnyes shing tshims gyur cig: oṃ pañca ḍā ki bh+yo sa ya si a mṛta ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi khā hi: ar+ghaṃ pa d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: bh+yo: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: 'gro ba'i don du skur sprul nas: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul: ma dang sring ltar sgrub la brtse: byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang mo nyer brgyad la bstod do: dam rdzas mchod gtor thugs dam bskang: thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: yams nad rims nad zhi ba dang: 'bru dang rkang 'gros 'phel rgyas mdzod: 'dod dgu thams cad dbang du sdus: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ma g.yel myur du las mdzod cig: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lha mo lnga yi thugs ka ru: hūm̐ḥ.a hrī niḥsaḥyis mtshan: gtso 'khor kun gyis sngags kyi sgra: 'brug stong ldir ba ltar du bzlas:

ri rab 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyoms: lha srin sde brgyad sngangs shing 'dar: byad mas byas pa'i bsam sbyor kun: kho rang thog tu log ste song: sku las gnam lcags drag po'i thog: tshwa tshwa'i tshul du dpag med 'phros: gnod byed thams cad gzhob tu bsreg: sku smad lcags bsregs phur pa ni: gnod byed rnams kyi snying la gzir: sgo gsum nus pa bcom par gyur: bh+yo hūm̐ tri ma nu khrom bh+yo: du du tsa sha nan: a kā ma ni khroṃ bh+yo: shad bu gyad bu nan: sa ra ma ni khroṃ bh+yo: tra ni tra ni nan: ni li dha ra khroṃ bh+yo: tri phuṃ tri phuṃ nan: tri sha tra khroṃ bh+yo: dun ting du nan: a hrī ni sa bh+yo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya phaṭa: sngags 'di ci lcogs bzla ba sgrub pa'o// bh+yo sa ya si bh+yo: brgya rtsa tsam bzla ba las sbyor ro// de nas zor lnga po byang*/ nub/ lho/ shar/ dbus ma rim par blangs te slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: byad zlog lha mo'i nus mthu yis: ban bon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: ye shes khro bo man chad nas: lha srin phran bu yan chad du: byad kha rbod gtong thams cad zlogs: nyams pa lha srung bcas pa kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag gyur cig: ces dang gong song sngags tshan gsum po brjod la phyogs gtsang sar 'phen du bcug / byad zlog lha mo mched lnga dang: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams: ma mo mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa'i gnas: byang shar chos kyi dbyings su gshegs: sarba dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī shwa rī badz+ra mu: gtor snod sbub steng*/ rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: rang nyid dran rdzogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin zhing gar thabs mdzad: gnod byed gdon bgegs dam sri thams cad rnams: rgya khab sa 'bol nang du btab pa ltar: rim dgu sa yi 'og tu tal ler song: gtor gzhong ri rab gling bzhis steng nas mnan: byams mgon ma byon bar du ma ldangs shig:

oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan: gtor gzhong gzed la 'bru 'thor/ ye dhar dang shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya/ des dgongs gter dbang phyug zor mdos kyi bka' gtad thob pa yin pas gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ ces pa tsam gyis 'grub bo// zhes pa'ang rtsis gto bca' mkhan sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i phyir du brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyis chags med gsung las khol du phyung ba dge legs 'phel// 'di la phyag len rgyas pa'i phyogs bya na/ thog mar bka' gtad kyi chas kyang bsham/ bsgom bzlas grub pa dang chos skyong spyi'i bka' gtad ltar bya/ mthar zor gtad pa man chad 'di ltar sbyar ba yin no// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
